framework: Prioritisation game (80 projects / 14 themes) or Ask Claude three-question roadmap

ask_claude_questions.text: Describe the organisation you are working to build.
What is currently holding you back?
Of those things holding you back, what is your top priority to work on right now?

projects.name: Strategic Plan Development & Facilitation
projects.painPoint: You are engaged in many good activities, but they don't add up to a coherent or powerful strategic direction.

projects.name: Write a business plan for a new initiative or organization overall
projects.painPoint: You have a game-changing idea for a new venture, but you can't get it on paper in a way that funders will take seriously.

projects.name: Develop a growth and change roadmap
projects.painPoint: You are growing fast and your old ways of working are starting to break.

projects.name: Theory of Change (ToC) Development
projects.painPoint: You have a strong belief that your work leads to impact, but you have never been explicit about why and how you think this will happen.

projects.name: Run an adaptive strategy workshop
projects.painPoint: Your strategy feels stale and you need to adapt to a changing environment.

projects.name: Facilitate a systems thinking workshop
projects.painPoint: You are stuck solving symptoms instead of addressing the root cause of your challenges.

projects.name: Align programming to a new ToC
projects.painPoint: Your programs are not fully aligned with your new strategic direction or Theory of Change.

projects.name: Team retreat
projects.painPoint: Your team needs time to reconnect, reflect, and realign around shared goals following change, conflict, growth, or remote/hybrid transitions.

projects.name: Project Management Framework (PMO Lite)
projects.painPoint: Your project timelines are constantly slipping, and everything feels rushed and last-minute.

projects.name: Project Management Skills Boost
projects.painPoint: Your team seems incredibly busy all the time, but you are not making progress on your most important strategic goals.

projects.name: Redesign your org chart and roles
projects.painPoint: Your organizational chart is a rigid pyramid that stifles innovation and cross-team collaboration. You've outgrown the flat structure you started with or you're expanding into new subject areas/ geographies, or the organisation has become too silo'd.

projects.name: Improve team productivity and time use
projects.painPoint: Your team seems incredibly busy all the time, but you are not making progress on your most important strategic goals.

projects.name: Support cross-team collaboration and role clarity
projects.painPoint: Different departments feel like they're working in silos and don't communicate youll.

projects.name: Clarify decision-making authority
projects.painPoint: There's no clarity on decision-making authority, so even small decisions get escalated to the top.

projects.name: Improve internal workflows
projects.painPoint: It feels like simple tasks require too many approvals and too much paperwork.

projects.name: Set up a new organisation
projects.painPoint: You are setting up a new organisation but you don't know where or how to go about it

projects.name: Strengthen board oversight and effectiveness
projects.painPoint: The board avoids difficult conversations about financial sustainability or underperforming programs.

projects.name: Board reporting, data and information
projects.painPoint: Your Board feels it does not have the right information to function properly

projects.name: Effective Board Meetings and Decision-Making
projects.painPoint: Your board meetings feel unproductive or decisions are delayed or unclear.

projects.name: Succession Planning for Board Leadership
projects.painPoint: Your board chair or key members may step down soon, and there’s no clear successor.

projects.name: Governance for Growing Organizations
projects.painPoint: Your organization has grown and your governance structures haven’t kept up.

projects.name: Governance for a new organisation
projects.painPoint: Your new organisation needs a board and you don't know how or why to set one up

projects.name: Aligned vision for governance
projects.painPoint: There are diffferent views on the Board on what the role of the Board is and how it should operate

projects.name: Tension between Board and the Executive
projects.painPoint: There is palpable tension between (parts of) the Board and the Executive, on key matters that need resolving

projects.name: Facilitate board review
projects.painPoint: There's no formal process for evaluating the performance of the board itself.

projects.name: Compensation & Benefits Framework
projects.painPoint: There are pay discrepancies between people doing similar work that seem to have no logical justification.

projects.name: Build a talent development framework
projects.painPoint: You don't invest in the professional development of your staff, and people feel like their careers are stagnating.

projects.name: Develop HR policies and procedures
projects.painPoint: Your employee policies are outdated, incomplete, and not easily accessible to staff.

projects.name: Support recruitment and onboarding improvements
projects.painPoint: Your hiring process is ad-hoc and inconsistent, and you frequently make bad hires.

projects.name: Create a remote onboarding experience
projects.painPoint: Your onboarding process for new hires is disorganized, especially for remote staff.

projects.name: Conduct a 360-degree leadership review
projects.painPoint: You know you have blind spots that are impacting your team, but I don't know what they are.

projects.name: Management Skills Development Program
projects.painPoint: Your managers were promoted because they were good at their jobs, not because they are good at managing people.

projects.name: Develop a personal leadership growth plan
projects.painPoint: You feel like I've hit a plateau in your development as a leader.

projects.name: Develop a leadership succession plan
projects.painPoint: If you're to get sick or leave suddenly, there is no one who could immediately step into your shoes.

projects.name: Identify and prepare future leaders
projects.painPoint: You have talented mid-level staff, but no clear pathway for them to grow into leadership roles.

projects.name: Accountability with Impact: Leading for Performance and Engagement
projects.painPoint: You are leader who is struggling to address underperformance in a way that drives accountability without causing disengagement or damaging relationships

projects.name: Leadership Coaching (Career Development)
projects.painPoint: You're an executive, senior leader, or high-potential manager navigating complex strategic decisions, organizational change, or high-stakes leadership transitions.

projects.name: Capacity Coaching
projects.painPoint: You're managing increased responsibilities, scaling a team or program, or facing persistent challenges in time, energy, or workflow management.

projects.name: Team Effectiveness & Collaboration (DISC)
projects.painPoint: There is a palpable lack of trust and psychological safety on your team.

projects.name: Change Management & Organizational Transformation
projects.painPoint: Every attempt to introduce a new process or system is met with powerful resistance.

projects.name: Address burnout and workload balance
projects.painPoint: Your "work hard" culture is discouraging people from taking time off to rest and recharge.

projects.name: Mediate internal team conflicts
projects.painPoint: A persistent conflict between two key staff members is creating a toxic environment for everyone.

projects.name: Train managers in conflict resolution
projects.painPoint: Managers are avoiding performance issues because they are afraid of conflict.

projects.name: Build values alignment across teams
projects.painPoint: There's a disconnect between your stated values and how different teams operate.

projects.name: Design a sustainability roadmap
projects.painPoint: Your organization's financial survival feels fragile and is a source of constant stress.

projects.name: Fundraising & Resource Mobilization Strategy
projects.painPoint: Your fundraising income has plateaued, and your old methods are bringing in diminishing returns.

projects.name: Grant Writing & Proposal Development
projects.painPoint: You spend a huge amount of effort writing grant proposals that have a very low success rate.

projects.name: Pitch Deck & Funder Engagement Support
projects.painPoint: You need to secure a major grant or investment and your case for support isn't strong enough.

projects.name: Build a major donor pipeline
projects.painPoint: You are excellent at acquiring one-time donations but terrible at retaining donors and building loyalty.

projects.name: Funder mapping
projects.painPoint: You need to find new funders who's mission is aligned with yours.

projects.name: Fundraising Performance Metrics and Dashboards
projects.painPoint: You aren’t tracking fundraising results clearly or consistently.

projects.name: Surviving the Big Grant
projects.painPoint: Your main source of funding is about to disappear and you need to find other resourses

projects.name: Financial Management Systems & Health Check
projects.painPoint: Your financial reports are confusing and don't help you make strategic decisions. You are not confident that your finance processes meet minimum/good standards.

projects.name: Improve cash flow forecasting
projects.painPoint: You can't get a real-time, accurate picture of your cash flow, which makes you nervous.

projects.name: Budgeting for Strategic Priorities
projects.painPoint: Your budget/ financial plans doesn’t reflect your real goals or adapt to change.

projects.name: Build a reserves policy and financial health metrics
projects.painPoint: You have no financial reserves, so any unexpected event could become an existential crisis. Or you do have some reserves, but are not confident what a 'good level' to hold is for your organisation.

projects.name: Train program staff on financial accountability
projects.painPoint: Your program staff struggle to manage their budgets effectively, leading to over/underspend.

projects.name: Preparing for Financial Audits
projects.painPoint: You’re facing your first audit or want to improve how you prepare for them.

projects.name: How to create the best grant budget
projects.painPoint: You want to ensure that all costs are covered within the grant budget

projects.name: Design an effective advocacy campaign
projects.painPoint: You want to launch a public campaign, but you don't know how to mobilize your supporters effectively.

projects.name: Communications Strategy Development
projects.painPoint: Your communications feel completely reactive and chaotic; you lurch from one announcement to the next.

projects.name: Social Media Audit and Strategy
projects.painPoint: Your social media presence feels scattered, low-engagement, or misaligned with your brand.

projects.name: Brand Identity & Messaging Refresh
projects.painPoint: Your logo, website, and materials look unprofessional and dated, undermining your credibility.

projects.name: Advocacy & Communications Strategy
projects.painPoint: Your advocacy efforts and your general communications are not aligned and feel disconnected.

projects.name: Storytelling for Impact
projects.painPoint: Your organization struggles to communicate its impact in an emotionally compelling way.

projects.name: MEL System Design & Implementation
projects.painPoint: You meticulously collect a vast amount of data, but it just sits in a database and is never used for decision-making.

projects.name: Impact Assessment & Reporting
projects.painPoint: When a funder asks 'what was your impact?', you can only provide a list of activities you completed.

projects.name: Design a reflective learning cycle for your programs
projects.painPoint: You complete projects, but the lessons learned are never documented or shared in a systematic way.

projects.name: Evaluate effectiveness of existing program
projects.painPoint: You deliver training, but you have no idea if it leads to any real-world change in behavior or practice.

projects.name: Facilitate partner feedback mechanisms
projects.painPoint: You don't have a good way to get honest feedback from your implementing partners.

projects.name: Build an internal knowledge-sharing system
projects.painPoint: When a key person leaves, all of their critical knowledge about projects and relationships leaves with them.

projects.name: Train staff on tech tools security
projects.painPoint: A significant portion of your staff lacks the basic digital literacy to use your tools effectively.

projects.name: Conduct a technology systems audit
projects.painPoint: You are paying for multiple redundant software subscriptions but have no central tech strategy.

projects.name: Digital Transformation Strategy
projects.painPoint: You are watching new technologies like AI from the sidelines, feeling overwhelmed and left behind.

projects.name: Improve remote and hybrid team performance
projects.painPoint: Your remote/hybrid team struggles with communication and collaboration.

projects.name: Technology Systems Implementation (CRM, Project Management)
projects.painPoint: Your data is fragmented across dozens of disconnected spreadsheets and systems.

projects.name: Safeguarding Policy & Framework Development
projects.painPoint: Your safeguarding policy is a generic template, not a practical document that is embedded in your daily operations.

projects.name: Map and assess strategic risks
projects.painPoint: When your board asks about the top risks to your strategy, you don't have a structured or comprehensive ansyour.

projects.name: Design a strategic foresight process
projects.painPoint: You only think about risks after something bad has already happened.

projects.name: Create a responsible data use policy
projects.painPoint: You collect highly sensitive client information, and you're not confident your storage and access protocols are secure.
